geometry_edits.rationale: Convert the end condition into a courtyard so the mass engages the street edge with a real public void.
Size the courtyard as occupiable open ground, not a token notch.
Align the opening with the program-frame access side.

graph_edits.rationale: Replace the purely cantilevered ending with a courtyard/public-void operator to make the street edge read as an active threshold rather than a sealed mass.
Keep the void large enough to be legible as usable neighborhood public space.
Open the court toward the verified access side in the program frame to strengthen the public threshold.

rationale: The four views read as one coherent bent-and-capped compact mass with consistent silhouette across views, so it clears the single-gesture and repair gates. The dominant body sits legibly within the parcel and the blue frontage edge is acknowledged, but the access response is still weak: the form remains mostly sealed with only a modest edge relation, not a clearly public court/undercut. For neighborhood living, the mass is plausible as a compact mixed-use street building with a calm upper volume, and the stepped/curved roofline gives enough section interest to support the program without becoming arbitrary sculpture. Overall it is program-fit, though it would benefit from a more explicit carved public threshold.

reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Stacked/stepped upper mass over a legible lower datum; use upper variation while keeping the ground reading compact and programmatic.
